prompt: For each server in serverTable, ping it and email admin if down

steps.description: Get the total number of rows in the serverTable.
Loop through each server in the serverTable.
Exit the loop when the counter reaches the total number of rows.
Get the server name from the current row of the serverTable.
Ping the server to check its status.
Branch based on the ping result.
Send an email to the administrator if the server is down.
